description: This file contains the PHP class 'Affiliate' in the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account'. It defines methods for managing affiliate data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving affiliate information in the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class extends a system engine Model and interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to affiliate accounts.

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: Represents the Affiliate model extending the system engine's Model class, providing methods to manage affiliate data such as creation, update, retrieval, and deletion of affiliate records in the database.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Adds a new affiliate record for a customer, inserting data into the 'customer_affiliate' database table and handling approval procedures if configured.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates an existing affiliate record for a customer in the database, based on the provided data.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Deletes an affiliate record and associated reports from the database for the specified customer ID.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves the affiliate details for a given customer ID, returns an array with custom fields decoded from JSON.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Fetches affiliate data based on a unique tracking code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Records a report entry for an affiliate, including IP and country data.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Deletes all report entries associated with a specific customer ID.
